## The Untapped Talent Pool

Approximately 77 million Americans — nearly 1 in 3 — have some form of criminal record. Blanket exclusion policies remove a massive portion of the potential workforce during a period of widespread talent shortages.

### The Business Case

Companies with fair-chance hiring programs report:

- 82% of managers say fair-chance hires perform equal to or better than peers
- Lower turnover : Fair-chance hires stay 12-18% longer than average
- Higher loyalty : 85% report strong organizational commitment
- Tax benefits : Work Opportunity Tax Credit (WOTC) of $2,400-$9,600 per eligible hire

### Best Practices for Implementation

#### 1. Adopt Ban-the-Box Policies

Remove criminal history questions from initial applications. Evaluate qualifications first.

#### 2. Individualized Assessment

When a criminal record surfaces:

Have questions about your hiring strategy?

Book a free 30-minute consultation with our team. No commitment, just practical advice.

- Nature and gravity of the offense
- Time elapsed since the offense
- Nature of the job and its relevance
- Evidence of rehabilitation

#### 3. Partner with Support Organizations

Work with reentry organizations that:

- Pre-screen and prepare candidates
- Provide ongoing support services
- Help with housing, transportation, and other barriers

#### 4. Train Hiring Managers

Address concerns proactively:

- Share data on fair-chance hire performance
- Provide decision-making frameworks
- Create escalation paths for concerns

#### 5. Supportive Onboarding

Fair-chance hires may need additional support:

- Assigned mentors
- Financial literacy resources
- Flexible scheduling for parole/probation requirements
- Clear communication of expectations

### Industries Leading the Way

Major employers embracing fair-chance hiring:

- Manufacturing (60% of employers open to fair-chance)
- Construction (55%)
- Food service (50%)
- Technology (growing trend)

### Getting Started

- Review current policies for blanket exclusions
- Train HR and hiring managers
- Partner with one reentry organization
- Pilot with 3-5 positions
- Measure outcomes at 90 days and 1 year

Fair-chance hiring expands your talent pool significantly. Combined with subscription sourcing , it creates a diverse pipeline that traditional approaches miss.
